sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the verified Static Calculation requirement: ship-owned quantities use QUDT QuantityValue nodes with correct datatypes and units; load-case radius and weakest-direction evidence are required outside the mutually exclusive approved-analysis/direct-calculation alternatives; the direct branch checks the reference-strength formula and uses its derived result in the tolerance-based ultimate-load formula; and blade-failure status uses the correct strict threshold comparison. Deterministic validation is valid and no canonical vocabulary repair is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance.
